_meta: URP Volume profile attached to UILotteryCharacterAppear/container/centers/PostProcess00. Source: VolumeProfile asset 'LotteryCharacterAppear_00' (pid -1517929857935513794) in CAB-f9e508424271ae846079d01ada5df0b8 (assetpack 98ca982a31f9b719913f248b5f0d5e51). The Volume's m_IsGlobal=1, so the profile applies to the URP camera globally during CharacterAppear (weight=0 at Default, weight=1 at In, weight=0 at Out — see character_appear_anim.json controller states). Five VolumeComponents are present; only those with active=1 are listed in `enabledOverrides`. SplitToning and RadialBlur are active=0 in the asset and are intentionally disabled.

Bloom.note: URP Bloom is an HDR-threshold radial-blur-add pass — only pixels with luminance >= threshold are bloomed. Browser CSS has no direct equivalent. A CSS `filter: blur(...)` over a tonemapped layer is a partial approximation but cannot match Unity's HDR-based selection. Pre-rendering or a WebGL post-process pass is the only exact route.

ColorAdjustments.note: URP ColorAdjustments contrast slider is in [-100, 100] range; value 43 maps to approximately CSS `filter: contrast(1.43)` (the Unity slider linearly biases the contrast curve).

Vignette.note: Vignette: dark-green tinted radial-falloff overlay centered at screen midpoint. Intensity 0.534 means the corners reach ~53% of the tint color. Reproducible in CSS via an absolute-positioned radial-gradient overlay.
